competitive_signals.observed: A seller recorded that the buyer said Teams Phone was included in their enterprise licence renewal
competitive_signals.interpretation: The buyer may see Phone as free, which weakens a separate Phone case
competitive_signals.known_gaps: Not verified with the customer; one note; licence terms unknown
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Lead with call quality and carrier choice; test a Phone plus Contact Center package

competitive_signals.observed: A rival AI assistant was mentioned as included in the base licence on one call
competitive_signals.interpretation: AI may be seen as part of the base price
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Show paid-AI usage proof at renewal; test an AI bundle

competitive_signals.observed: A buyer cited a lower per-seat quote from a rival on two calls
competitive_signals.known_gaps: Quote not seen; seat counts may differ
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Hold the discount line; trade term length for price

competitive_signals.observed: Two lost contact center deals recorded a rival with a lower price as the reason
competitive_signals.interpretation: Price may be a factor in displacement deals
competitive_signals.known_gaps: Loss reasons are self-reported by sellers
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Do not match on price; lead with Phone attach; offer a pilot

competitive_signals.observed: A partner reported a rival launching agent-assist features
competitive_signals.interpretation: May raise buyer expectations for AI in contact center
competitive_signals.known_gaps: Feature set and availability not verified
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Show AI features inside Contact Center; offer paid-AI pilots where Contact Center is already owned

competitive_signals.observed: Two regional carriers were reported to be reselling a rival hosted phone service
competitive_signals.interpretation: The rival may reach buyers through carriers Zoom does not use
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Test a partner-led Phone migration offer with carriers

competitive_signals.observed: A buyer mentioned migration credits from a rival for legacy phone estates
competitive_signals.interpretation: Legacy estates may be a rival target
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Target the same estates with a migration plan and a price lock

competitive_signals.observed: Rival room systems were mentioned in two hybrid-work refresh discussions
competitive_signals.interpretation: Rooms may decide which platform the buyer picks
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Lead with Workplace plus Rooms and a seat ramp

competitive_signals.observed: A buyer said a rival AI assistant came bundled with their productivity suite
competitive_signals.interpretation: Free AI may reduce willingness to pay for an AI add-on
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Offer the AI trial where a rival is named; show activation

competitive_signals.observed: Procurement at two accounts asked to consolidate vendors inside an enterprise agreement
competitive_signals.interpretation: Consolidation may favor the incumbent suite
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Win the phone, rooms and contact center use cases; engage procurement early

competitive_signals.observed: A partner reported expanding integrator partnerships
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Sign two integrators; start from the Phone base

competitive_signals.observed: Entry pricing for mid-size contact centers was mentioned once
competitive_signals.interpretation: Mid-size accounts may be price sensitive
competitive_signals.suggested_response: Protect Large accounts; use seat ramps for Medium

levers.what_it_changes: Pipeline cover that counts as healthy. Raise it and more region and product cells turn amber or red.
Accounts below this health score need repair. Raise it and more accounts, and more revenue, count as at risk.
Days without activity before a deal counts as quiet (and stops counting as healthy execution).
Discount above which a deal needs a written reason.
Win chance added when a customer executive sponsors the deal (prototype rule).
Win chance removed when no executive sponsors the deal (prototype rule). Raise it and the risk-adjusted forecast falls further below the sales team forecast.
Win chance removed when a competitor is named on the deal (prototype rule).
Performance column: closed-won against the plan that has elapsed. At or above this is green.
Performance column: from here up to the green line is amber; below it is red.
Forecast column: expected landing against the full-year plan. At or above this is green.
Forecast column: from here up to the green line is amber; below it is red.
Net revenue retention this far below the group forecast turns the retention status amber.
Net revenue retention this far below the group forecast turns the retention status red.
Revenue at risk as a share of yearly revenue above this is amber.
Revenue at risk as a share of yearly revenue above this is red.
Growth execution: share of open pipeline value that has an executive sponsor, recent activity and two or more contacts. At or above this is green.
Growth execution: from here up to the green line is amber; below it is red.
Competitive exposure: share of open pipeline value that names a rival. Above this is amber.
Competitive exposure: above this is red.
Retention shows "insufficient data" instead of a colour when a group has fewer accounts than this.
Growth execution and competitive exposure show "insufficient data" when fewer open deals than this back them.
Yearly revenue at or above this makes an account Large.
Yearly revenue at or above this (and below Large) makes an account Medium; below is Small.
Assumed share of next quarter plan that is created and closed inside the quarter. Part of the baseline forecast, shown separately.
Share of fixable open deals where the intervention works within the quarter.
Share of at-risk renewal revenue a rescue plan saves.
Share of unopened expansion revenue that converts to bookings once an opportunity is opened.
Share of that conversion that can close before the fiscal year ends (expansion cycles are about 110 days).
A forecast counts as right when it lands within this band of the final actual.
The forecast has caught up with reality once it is within this band of the final actual; the week it gets there is the lag.
Open pipeline one account executive can work well across the current and next quarter.
Open implementation projects one solutions engineer or success manager can run well.

salesforce.change: Edit the record in Salesforce; RevOps approves bulk changes

gong.change: Correct call tags in Gong; Enablement approves taxonomy changes

grafana.change: Fix the dashboard query or data source in Grafana; Product Analytics approves

monday.change: Update the project board in monday.com; the project owner confirms

external.change: Request a refresh from the data vendor; RevOps approves the account match

marketing.change: Fix the campaign or lead record in the marketing platform; Marketing Operations approves attribution rules

planning.change: Change the plan in the planning workbook; Finance and the CRO approve

market.change: Add or correct the signal in the win-loss log; Product Marketing approves

workbook.change: Edit the assumption in the workbook; the CRO approves on the Decide tab
